name: Dumbbell Step-Up to Curl
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and place your working foot flat on top of the box.
Push through your elevated foot to stand on the box and bring your trailing foot up beside it.
At the top, keep your elbows tucked at your sides and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders with palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells back to your sides, step down slowly with control, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Stabilize your balance at the top of the box before curling so you do not swing the weights.
Control the step-down instead of dropping heavily onto your back foot.
